answer: Here is one concrete wall: Sealed engraver guild membership with engravers guild attestation. It works because a membership the guild kept across years of workshops, and the willow it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the spiral for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The relic is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
